name: ritlibrary-monorepo
description: RIT Library - Academic resource portal with notes, PYQs, and syllabus tracking

scripts.test: npm --prefix my-project test && npm --prefix library-backend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix my-project run test:coverage && npm --prefix library-backend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix my-project run lint && npm --prefix library-backend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix my-project run format && npm --prefix library-backend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix my-project run format:check && npm --prefix library-backend run format:check

author: RIT Library Team
